key_insight: HazardWeaver turns hazard analysis into state-dependent route selection, choosing scientific methods that are both applicable to the event and executable with available data and tools.
engineering_relevance: It can help build more reliable disaster-analysis agents that adapt workflows as evidence changes, improving automated decision-making for real-world hazard assessment.
method: Hazard Knowledge Compiler extracts evidence-linked conditions that govern when scientific methods are applicable.
Hazard Capability Graph encodes executable scientific capabilities and checks input/output compatibility between tools and workflows.
Hazard Weaver Agent selects, executes, and revises scientific routes as analysis state changes.
evidence_signal: Evaluated on the Hazard Weaver Benchmark with 141 instances across seven single-hazard domains and four multi-hazard interaction classes, measuring output correctness, route validity, and justified abstention.
watch_item: Performance depends on accurately encoding applicability conditions and capability compatibility, which may be difficult to maintain as scientific tools and hazard contexts evolve.
paper_title: HazardWeaver: Scientific Route Selection for Hazard Analysis Agents
